objective_text: Identify types of number, including primes, squares, cubes and rational and irrational numbers, and apply the correct order of operations.
Convert between fractions, decimals and percentages and calculate a percentage of a quantity with and without a calculator.
Simplify ratios and solve problems involving direct and inverse proportion.
Apply the laws of indices and convert numbers to and from standard form.
Round numbers to a given degree of accuracy, estimate calculations and state upper and lower bounds.
Expand single and double brackets and factorise algebraic expressions by taking out common factors.
Solve linear equations, including those with fractions, and represent the solution of an inequality on a number line.
Solve simultaneous linear equations using elimination and substitution.
Solve quadratic equations by factorising and by using the quadratic formula.
Continue linear and quadratic sequences and find the nth term of a linear sequence.
Plot and interpret straight-line graphs of the form y = mx + c from a table of values.
Calculate the gradient of a straight line and interpret the gradient and intercept in context.
Calculate the midpoint and the length of a line segment joining two points.
Recognise and sketch the graphs of quadratic, cubic and reciprocal functions, identifying key features.
Use the relationships between the gradients of parallel and perpendicular lines to solve problems.
